name: project-sentinel
description: Project Sentinel: An Intelligent Observability & Autonomous Recovery Framework

scripts.install-backend: pnpm install || yarn install || npm install
scripts.install-frontend: cd frontend && (pnpm install || yarn install || npm install)
scripts.install-all: npm run install-backend && npm run install-frontend
scripts.build-frontend: cd frontend && (pnpm run build || yarn build || npm run build)
scripts.dev-frontend: cd frontend && (pnpm run dev || yarn dev || npm run dev)
